c2e3dc0a.text:
There are four rules to magic:

   Magic is powerful.
   Magic is corrupting.
   Magic is addicting.
   Magic draws the denizens of the Twisting Nether to those who wield the arcane.

Those rules you can always guarantee. Those rules will govern your destiny if you chose to continue down the path as a $c.

If you're foolish enough to ignore this warning, then come speak to me inside the library wing of the abbey in Northshire. I'll be waiting for you upstairs.

-Khelden Bremen, $C Trainer
c2e3dc0a.title: Glyphic Letter

f6f4dcb7.text:
Greetings $N,

I've been observing your handiwork for some time now. I must say, I'm impressed. You're clearly no mere street urchin.

There's a job I'd like you to do for me; the retrieval of a certain treasure. I assure you the pay is lucrative.

If you're interested, I've left a dead drop in a cabin beside Pyrewood Village. You'll find more information within.

Regards, 
C

Grimand Elmore, at your service!

1430|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

14723|240f95e3.name: Mistina Steelshield
14723|240f95e3.text:
Aye, you there!  If you want to earn the respect of the dwarves of Ironforge, then you can start by donating valuable resources!  Ironforge finds itself running low on cloth piece; textiles and bandages don't grow on trees, ya know!

Rather than cash in various cloth pieces you find adventuring, donate them!  Doing so will earn you the recognition of the dwarven people of Ironforge!

14724|92b80d28.name: Bubulo Acerbus
14724|92b80d28.text:
The exiles of Gnomeregan find ourselves in even more dire straits by running low on cloth reserves!  Perhaps you can help us, eh?!

Bring me extra cloth pieces you might have to help us replenish our stocks.  By donating them, you'll be earning the respect and trust of gnomes everywhere.  That's something that money can't buy!  Well, I guess cloth does, but that's beside the point...

1569|e2fc85be.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
1569|e2fc85be.text: No other race on Azeroth has suffered as much as our people, $c. To laugh in the face of death has become second nature for all of us.

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

1632|fee38227.name: Adele Fielder
1632|fee38227.text: Since my husband left for the front, Helene here has been my strength. Her kind heart and sharp sword have helped me through a lot of tough times. I don't know what I would've done without her.

1651|c2467ddc.name: Lee Brown
1651|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

1703|d69277e0.name: Uthrar Threx
1703|d69277e0.text: Excellent! I've been hopin' for a new student. Well, let's get started right away then!

197|877c25a9.name: Marshal McBride
197|877c25a9.text: Hey, citizen!  You look like a stout one.  We guards are spread a little thin out here, and I could use your help...

198|9c6df40b.name: Khelden Bremen
198|9c6df40b.text: Greetings $c.  Shall I provide you with further insight into the world of magic?

2124|544e5c2b.name: Isabella
2124|544e5c2b.text: Well met, $c.  My advice to you is this: as you travel the world, be wary of magic for it will burn the untrained.

2126|db7f8bbb.name: Maximillion

240|3ccc4430.text: Ach, it's hard enough keeping order around here without all these new troubles popping up! I hope you have good news, $N...

2456|105cd232.name: Newton Burnside
2456|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

247226|58a0ba23.name: Kelsey Fargo
247226|58a0ba23.text: Blast these kobolds. I can't get any work done with them running back and forth, getting in my way. Well, I've got nothing better to do. Would you like to learn about mining techniques? Or perhaps you just need some new tools?

247229|466d697a.name: Daniel
247229|466d697a.text:
Professions are divided between two main categories: primary and secondary.

You are limited to a maximum of two primary professions at a time. You can abandon your skill in a primary profession at any time; however, the wealth of knowledge you gathered for it will be lost. If you choose to return to your original profession, you will need to train from the basics and seek out recipes you previously acquired to refamiliarize yourself with them.

Secondary professions do not have such a limit. These skills tend to err towards self-sufficiency with your basic survival needs. You are free to train any or all of these, but may find fewer opportunities to turn a profit.

247229|55b52cc4.name: Daniel
247229|55b52cc4.text: What does Brother Paxton need now?

247229|83e0509a.name: Daniel
247229|83e0509a.text:
Hello, $N! Have you considered taking up a tradeskill?

I would be happy to answer any questions you might have, or point you toward the local trainers.

If this feels overwhelming, that's okay! You can always return here or visit trainers in capital cities to get started on your crafting journey at any time.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

5145|8fca8484.name: Juli Stormkettle
5145|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

514|aa4da6d8.name: Smith Argus
514|aa4da6d8.text: If you'd like to learn how to blacksmith your own weapons and armor, I'd be happy to help.

5153|ab3a58ee.text: I don't have time to babysit! Go talk to me assistant, Uthrar!

5157|dfaa46dd.name: Gimble Thistlefuzz
5157|dfaa46dd.text: You're joking, right? I believe you're looking for the OTHER short fellow, Thonys Pillarstone. He's downstairs. Now skedaddle!

523|d6469a91.name: Thor

5509|54ca4be4.name: Kathrum Axehand
5509|54ca4be4.text: Don't let the humans in the Bazaar fool ye lass, with the subway those gnomes built it's easier than ye might think to transport goods from Ironforge. If they try to tack on import fees just tell them yer gonna buy yer gear from me.

5567|1ec9aba6.name: Sellandus
5567|1ec9aba6.text: Speak with Lawrence Shneider at Duncan's Textiles around the corner to the left. He is adept at dealing with beginners.

5595|21c84810.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|21c84810.text: Where is the Auction House?  Why it's right by the gates of Ironforge as you enter our fine city.  Ye'll find it just across from The Vault.

5595|3804779b.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|3804779b.text: Which class trainer might ye be looking for?

5595|5ba67714.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|5ba67714.text: Aye, and which battleground be ye looking for?

5595|7a20e7fe.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|7a20e7fe.text: That Jormund Stonebrow has a knack for the needle, he does.  Should you be needing some training, then you'll find him at Stonebrow's Clothier on the northern side of The Great Forge.

5595|8f560eff.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|8f560eff.text: Which profession trainer would ye be looking for?

5595|b3938781.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|b3938781.text:
Och!  Ye should be careful what ye get enchanted lass.  I had me mug enchanted so it wouldn't spill a drop, but now I can't drink from it!  Such a tragedy.  

You be sure to heed me advice when ye see Gimble.  He'll be in his shop right by the Gryphon Master at The Great Forge.

5595|bb6f725c.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|bb6f725c.text: Well ye'd be sure to find some training in the magical arts over in the Hall of Mysteries, north of the gates of Ironforge.  Juli Stormkettle can always be found there with her nose in a book.

5595|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

5595|fd9e217b.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|fd9e217b.text: Yer looking to learn how to use a new weapon are ye?  Well, ye should be talking to Bixi or Buliwyf over at the Timberline Arms weapon shop then lass.  They know their weapons from axes to... uh... zweihanders.

5694|f9a7a324.name: High Sorcerer Andromath
5694|f9a7a324.text: The flow of magic is unpredictable and chaotic, of late. What, I wonder, could be the cause of this?

5749|721fd095.name: Kayla Smithe
5749|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6740|4a0923b3.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|4a0923b3.text: Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?

6740|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

68|0e43b9cc.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|0e43b9cc.text: Stormwind Counting House is located by the front gates in the trade district of Stormwind. And when you get tired of counting your money, be sure to stop by the Gilded Rose for a drink.

68|4e0ec384.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|4e0ec384.text: Which profession trainer are you looking for?

68|819b99eb.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|819b99eb.text: Lucan Cordell has a small shop on the canal by the Stockade. I am sure he will be able to teach you the art of enchanting.

68|9e9bec9c.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|9e9bec9c.text: What do you need directions to?

7232|e03d94ba.name: Borgus Steelhand
7232|e03d94ba.text: Can't ye see I'm busy? This had better be good.

7312|2e7e3377.name: Dink
7312|2e7e3377.text: Greetings.  I'm a gnome $c trainer, and you're a $c.

9099|07b284ab.name: Sraaz
9099|07b284ab.text: This cherry pie tastes so good, it could make a grown gnome cry.

9099|e8063847.name: Sraaz
9099|e8063847.text: Cherry pie is my favoritist food in all of Azeroth.

918|a0b51800.name: Osborne the Night Man
918|a0b51800.text: You look like the type I should watch my coin purse around. Something I can help you with?

7802-progress.name: Mistina Steelshield
7802-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Ironforge for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7802-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

91741-accept.text:

Brother Paxton inside the abbey has a small library he maintains. The book must have come from there.>

96391-accept.name: Unknown
96391-accept.text:
<The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath Ironforge itself.

You can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it, urging you to seek out an Earthseer named "Farsen".>
96391-accept.title: Underground Map

I... rest...
